correctness.rationale: All 12 explicit vertices and 24 edges are reconstructed. For all normals in the open ordered fundamental cone, each of 24 neighbor-height signs is fixed by three exact extreme-ray tests. Event increments prove the complete N=8,6,4 slice profile with breakpoints x-z, x+z, x+y; all exceptional planes form a measure-zero set. Stokes spherical triangle integration gives the three exact arctangent probabilities, verified by an independent boundary-arc evaluation and normalization/expectation checks. The code is supplementary and the written argument supplies full quantifiers.

value.rationale: A full exact natural geometric-probability law for the quasiregular cuboctahedron, with unexpectedly even-sided almost-sure sections, a three-threshold direction law, and a nontrivial affine-invariance distinction. No arbitrary parameter choice or known invariant-table recomputation is involved; the exact classification is useful for stereological comparisons and tests of polyhedral slicing models.
